description: This script measures the performance of adding files to a Git object database under various fsync configurations. It initializes repositories, populates them with files, and runs performance tests for different core.fsync settings such as 'none', 'loose-object', 'batch', and 'writeout-only', focusing on operations like add, stash, unpack, and commit.

methods.name: populate_files
methods.description: Creates a set of unique files across multiple directories for testing.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, makes an initial commit, and populates it with unique files.

methods.name: test_perf_fsync_cfgs
methods.description: Runs performance tests for various fsync configurations, covering operations like add, stash, unpack, and commit.
